about: W2b relation fixture (G-P1 CI replay, G-LIVE-B). One NEW item per group, compared with its EXISTING items; gold per pair. class: contra_new | contra_old | contra_none | duplicate | refines | near_miss | none. project: same | other (other = cross-project). t = valid_from (UTC midnight).
